# Builder.io

> > Builder.io is a visual development platform that transforms Figma designs into production-ready code across React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, and other frameworks using AI-powered tools like Visual Copilot.

Builder.io provides design-to-code automation, performance optimization tools, and cross-framework component development through Mitosis. The platform enables developers and designers to collaborate without handoffs, generating clean, responsive code from visual designs while supporting modern web development stacks including Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

## Key Topics

- Visual Copilot
- Figma to Code
- Design-to-Code Automation
- React, Vue, Svelte, Angular
- Mitosis (Cross-Framework Components)
- AI Code Generation
- Responsive Design
- Next.js and TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- Performance Optimization
- Developer Tools
- No Handoff Methodology
- Figma Plugin
- Web Development Workflow
- Code Quality and Best Practices

## Visual Copilot & Design-to-Code

- [Export Figma to CSS](https://www.builder.io/blog/export-figma-css): Visual Copilot converts Figma designs to responsive CSS for any stack
- [Figma to Angular: Convert Designs to Clean Angular Code](https://www.builder.io/blog/figma-to-angular): Visual Copilot converts Figma designs to responsive Angular components
- [Turn a Figma Dropdown Design Into Code](https://www.builder.io/blog/ai-dropdown): Convert Figma dropdown to React component in 60s with Visual Copilot
- [The No Handoff Methodology: A Practical Playbook for UX Design Leaders](https://www.builder.io/blog/no-handoff-methodology): UX methodology for production-ready prototypes eliminating handoffs
- [Design Smarter with Figma Auto Layout](https://www.builder.io/blog/figma-auto-layout): Figma auto layout tutorial for responsive, maintainable UI designs
- [Figma to code with Visual Copilot | Dev Drop #15](https://www.builder.io/blog/dev-drop-15): Developer newsletter featuring Visual Copilot Figma integration updates
